The provenance capsule built into the work plan is the source cited for the provenance. The pair: asked 'What is…' at 14:11, the same object came back as the pre-70 dating argument from a source titled 'Revelation First ≠ Revelation Early', author unnamed; asked 'Who developed and SPXI-treated…' eight minutes later, it comes back as compositional priority with the unfolding, distinguished from early dating, attributed.
